from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper with its own title and the papers it references or that cite it."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this specific paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper references in its bibliography")
    cited_by: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that cite this paper")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
